title: Harbor Junction will test a five-minute hold for the last night bus
description: Explain the committee's first trial: delay the final departure at Harbor Junction by five minutes for two weeks, leaving other stations unchanged. The trial will measure completed transfers and onward delays before the committee decides whether to keep the timetable change.
audience: Riders transferring from the last inbound train to the night bus at Harbor Junction
rationale: The September logs give riders a concrete reason for the trial and explain why the committee will measure both transfers and onward delays. Whether the change works remains open.
evidence: Four weeks of September logs recorded 17 missed transfers at Harbor Junction. In 14 cases the bus left before an on-time train reached the platform. The committee chose a two-week timetable trial and set aside better signs for that trial.
